citations.quote: make sure that they are registered in your name, so that the share registrar can send you dividends

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: To receive dividends, shareholder circulars and corporate documents directly from a Hong Kong issuer's share registrar, a physical-certificate holder must ensure the certificate is registered in the investor's own name; otherwise entitlements route to the registered (nominee) holder rather than the beneficial owner.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: HK Physical Certificates: Register in Your Own Name for Dividends
